modalities.evidence: Prostate transversal T2-weighted magnetic resonance images (MRIs) acquired on a 3.0T Siemens TrioTim

output.summary: Transversal T2-weighted prostate MRI acquired at 3.0T with a pelvic phased-array coil for prostate cancer detection, contributed to TCIA as part of an ISBI challenge competition in 2013.
